topic.title: Gold funds of funds stop taking new money: what stops and what keeps running for a gold SIP

trend.why_now: Since 15-16 October 2026, fund houses including Tata, UTI, ICICI Prudential, HDFC, Aditya Birla Sun Life, DSP and Invesco have stopped fresh lump sums, new SIPs, top-ups and switch-ins into their gold funds of funds on SEBI's instructions, till further notice; existing SIPs and redemptions continue and gold ETFs are not affected.

cta: Do you hold a gold fund?
title: Gold fund SIP turned away this week? What the pause means for you
description: Fund houses have paused new money into their gold funds of funds on SEBI's instructions. What is on hold, what keeps running, and what it means for a ₹3,000 monthly gold SIP. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
